'''''A Rodian Love Story''''' was a [[space opera]] performed at the [[Five Star Entertainment]] theater, located on the floating city [[Depatar/Legends|Depatar]] of [[Genarius]]. The theater's [[Human/Legends|Human]] doorman, [[Danil]], did not particularly recommend the show to patrons of the theater.
